## Ctx.handleSessionCommandCaptionVideo() method

Optional `handleSessionCommandCaptionVideo` route handler declaration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
handleSessionCommandCaptionVideo?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Executed on `video` updates while the session is active. Routing id=1 (session) runs BEFORE static/intent matching (id=2-3): it reads `ctx.getSession().method` — set via [Ctx.setSessionCommandCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.setsessioncommandcaptionvideo.md) which wires [Ctx.methodSessionCommandCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessioncommandcaptionvideo.md) — and dispatches this handler through `new Page(ctx)`<!-- -->. When no session is active, the same update falls through to the non-session route [Ctx.handleCommandCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.handlecommandcaptionvideo.md) instead.
